decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1.	The proposed development would, by reason of its siting, size and design, constitute an overdevelopment of the site and fail to meet Council housing standards representing inappropriate development. The proposal would be a cramped form of development, out of character with the locality and detrimental to the visual amenities of the local area and residential amenities of the adjoining neighbours.  The proposal is contrary to policies ENV.1.1, H.1.2 and H.3.3 of the Adopted Unitary Development Plan and policies ENV-B.1.1, H.4.1 and H.6.3 of the Revised Deposit Unitary Development Plan and associated Supplementary Planning Guidance.
description: Erection of attached 2 storey 2 bedroom end of terrace house with parking in the rear garden
